 const fee=Math.min(pl.cash,Math.round(pl.cash*.15));pl.cash-=fee;for(const k in pl.ammo)pl.ammo[k]=Math.floor(pl.ammo[k]/2);setTimeout(()=>respawn(PD,'Fined $'+fee+' · half your ammo confiscated'),3000)}

functions.code: function policeLineOfSight(x,y,z){const dx=pl.x-x,dz=pl.z-z,dy=pl.y+1.2-y,d=Math.hypot(dx,dz);for(let t=1.5;t<d-.8;t+=1.5){const f=t/d,px=x+dx*f,pz=z+dz*f,py=y+dy*f,gh=heightAt(px,pz);if(py<gh+.1)return false;for(const b of queryCols(px,pz,.2))if(px>b.x0&&px<b.x1&&pz>b.z0&&pz<b.z1&&py<gh+b.h)return false}return true}
